llm.summary: The skill artifacts are coherent maintainer and Convex workflow instructions with disclosed command use and no evidence of hidden installation, exfiltration, or automatic persistence.

dimensions.detail: The capabilities fit the stated purposes: Convex setup, migrations, performance audits, ClawHub UI proof, PR review, and staff moderation. High-impact moderation commands are disclosed as staff actions with API auth, audit logging, explicit targets, reasons, and confirmation before writes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The autoreview helper can run nested Codex review with full access by default and may fall back to other local reviewer CLIs using generated diffs. This is disclosed and purpose-aligned for code review, but users should understand that diffs may be sent to configured external tools.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifacts are skill markdown, reference files, icons, small agent metadata, and one local helper script. I found no install-time hooks, package postinstall behavior, or automatic execution path.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Commands such as bun, npx convex, gh, proof tooling, and the repo-local moderation CLI are proportional to the workflows described. Auth and deployment steps are called out as user-controlled or interactive where needed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background persistence or privilege escalation is present. Some workflows intentionally mutate project files, Convex deployments, PR comments, or moderation state, but the instructions require user scope, confirmation, verification, or normal authenticated APIs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want these maintainer and Convex workflows. Be careful with the moderation skill because it can affect real users and public skill state when used with staff credentials, and review the autoreview helper settings before allowing full-access nested reviews or fallback reviewer CLIs that may receive repository diffs.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; local review did not find artifact-backed agentic-risk concerns that would override that result.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean with no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not solely determine the benign verdict.
